speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you describe the nature and location of your flank pain, and has it been accompanied by any changes in urination? Also, which antibiotic were you prescribed for your sinusitis, and how long did you take it?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any burning sensation when urinating, or is your urine cloudy or bloody? Additionally, can you tell me the specific name of the antibiotic you were prescribed and exactly how many days you took it?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does your urine have a foul odor, and are you experiencing any chills or nausea along with your fever? Also, have you had any recent dental work or skin infections?

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.

speaker: Doctor
text: REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis and Urine Culture. Do you recall if the fever started specifically after switching to cephalexin, and have you noticed any new swelling or redness on your skin?

text: RESULTS: Urinalysis shows Leukocyturia (Present). Urine Culture (Bacterial_Culture) is Negative. Additional findings from cytospin stained with Hansel’s solution reveal 3% binucleated cells with eosinophilic, granular cytoplasm.
